prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests.
Sign-in reorder changes were helpful in 2 tests, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made performance worse in 2 tests and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.4% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.8% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 86.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Launch Pad Redesign: Redesign the final home_intro screen into a stage layout featuring an animated pet mascot preview and a prominent launch action button. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and takes a median 395s; support emails also indicate users are unclear on how to summon or interact with their pet.)
1: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Two-Column Layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a two-column layout separating companion personality settings from pet naming. (why: Adoption step conversion is 71.7% with an 89s median time; organizing form inputs into distinct columns reduces visual friction.)
2: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync Benefit Toast Notification: Add a prominent notification banner to the sign-in screen reinforcing that signing in guarantees pet progress cloud backup. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, making cloud sync clarity vital.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Data Protection Hint: Add an explicit safeguard hint explaining that existing account data will automatically restore without replacing newly selected pets. (why: 8 support emails cited accounts resetting or pets disappearing after re-authentication.)

scores.note: Finish step has highest drop-off (64.8%) and strong support evidence, but redesigns and finish screen additions historically underperform.
Adoption step has noticeable drop-off, but no support mail evidence is cited and past adoption layout/redesign tests yielded negative lifts.
Sign-in drop-off is lower, but strong support complaints align with previous positive results for sign-in notifications.
Directly addresses explicit support complaints with low implementation cost (text/config hint) and favorable sign-in test trends.
